properties.name: cibseven.webclient.custom.spring.jackson.serialization.write-dates-as-timestamps
properties.description: Serializes dates as epoch millis instead of ISO-8601. Legacy opt-out for consumers that adapted to the output the webclient produced before the date-format fix. Applies to java.util.Date and java.sql.Timestamp (epoch millis) as well as java.time types (numeric arrays or fractional seconds).

deprecation.reason: Interim opt-out while consumers migrate to ISO-8601. Jackson 3 disables timestamp output by default, so this flag loses its purpose once the wire layer moves to Jackson 3; prefer adapting the consumer or annotating the affected field with @JsonFormat.
